title: surge (poetics of flight)
medium: Oil, graphite, ink, marker pen, and crayon over intaglio on paper

said.q: Murillo incites his own practice in new directions as a way to, in the artist’s words, “keep a balance between my desire to think primarily about image-making and mark-making, textures and form, and this constant awareness of the world and my need to interpret it.”[1] The present work marks a new evolution of the artist’s surge series, initiated in 2018, in which Murillo uses his own etchings as a support. As with earlier surge paintings, the act of layering is crucial to Murillo’s conception of the work.
said.by: Anderson Ranch Arts Center Benefit Auction, on Artsy

events.n: copper plates etched, where the artist stayed for much of the pandemic
events.q: the original copper plates were etched in Colombia
then printed in the United States
finally covered over with paint in London
